stem: A controller uses one sensor that has not been checked for months. Crop symptoms and a recently calibrated handheld meter disagree with the controller. Which action has the strongest measurement rationale?
choices: Verify the installed sensor against a known reference and document any offset before changing environmental targets
Trust the controller because installed sensors cannot drift
Change VPD targets until the controller matches the desired number
Ignore the handheld meter because calibration is unnecessary
rationale: Sensor drift can create systematic control error. Verification against a known reference should precede target changes when measurements conflict.
